blocks.text: For the genitive plural of год the word лет is used.
«For the genitive plural of the noun **год** the word **лет** is used: **один год**, **два года**, **пять лет**.»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Мэри начала пользоваться омолаживающим кремом с 14 ___ (годы).
exercises.prompt: Mary started using anti-aging cream when she was 14.
exercises.why: «For the genitive plural of the noun год the word лет is used: один год, два года, пять лет.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.
exercises.context: For the genitive plural of год the word лет is used. (DLI, Lesson 41)
